description: This file defines functions for interacting with user data via API calls in a JavaScript frontend project. It exports methods to retrieve a user's projects and basic user info from backend endpoints, utilizing an API client abstraction.

methods.name: getUserProjects(userId, params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a user's projects from the backend API, allowing optional date range and organization filters.
parameters: params (object with tenantId, organizationId, from, to)

methods.name: getUserBasic(userId)
methods.description: Retrieves minimal user information (id and name) using a user ID, handling not found errors gracefully.
